title: Ranking Function Generation with LLMs for Termination
abstract: arXiv:2610.35523v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Ranking functions are a fundamental technique for proving loop termination, but constructing them manually is challenging and requires substantial expertise. We propose RAINFALL, a neuro-symbolic framework which follows the generate-verify-refine paradigm and tightly integrates LLMs with symbolic verification. RAINFALL formulates ranking function synthesis as a code-completion task by inserting placeholders into the input program and constraining the LLM to fill four predefined slots for each loop. The completed program is then checked by a symbolic verifier. If verification succeeds, a valid ranking function is obtained; otherwise, the verifier's diagnostics are translated into natural-language feedback that guides iterative refinement of the LLM's output. We evaluate RAINFALL on two public benchmark suites comprising 358 terminating C programs. Using MiniMax V2.7, RAINFALL synthesizes verifiable ranking functions for 323 programs (90

translated_title: 基于大语言模型的排序函数生成用于终止性证明
translated_abstract: 排序函数是证明循环终止性的基础技术，但手动构造排序函数具有挑战性且需要大量专业知识。我们提出了RAINFALL，这是一个神经符号框架，遵循生成-验证-改进范式，将大语言模型与符号验证紧密集成。RAINFALL将排序函数合成任务表述为代码补全任务，通过在输入程序中插入占位符，并约束大语言模型为每个循环填充四个预定义的槽位。补全后的程序随后由符号验证器进行检查。如果验证成功，则获得有效的排序函数；否则，验证器的诊断信息会被转换为自然语言反馈，以指导大语言模型输出的迭代改进。我们在两个公开基准测试套件上对RAINFALL进行了评估，共包含358个可终止的C程序。使用MiniMax V2.7，RAINFALL成功为323个程序（90……）合成了可验证的排序函数
tldr: 该论文提出RAINFALL神经符号框架，通过将排序函数合成转化为带槽位约束的代码补全任务，并结合符号验证器的反馈迭代改进，利用大语言模型自动生成可验证的排序函数以证明循环终止性。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes RAINFALL, a neuro-symbolic framework that formulates ranking function synthesis as slot-constrained code completion for LLMs and iteratively refines outputs using symbolic verifier feedback, enabling automated generation of verifiable ranking functions for proving loop termination.
